content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPI Chief Administrative Officer-cum-Registrar (A-VIII) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the STPI Chief Administrative Officer-cum-Registrar (A-VIII) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the STPI Chief Administrative Officer-cum-Registrar (A-VIII) recruitment is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBA/Post Graduate degree in any discipline or a Graduate degree with a PG Diploma in management, along with 15 years of relevant experience in Personnel Management and Labour Laws.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for specific categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chief Administrative Officer-cum-Registrar post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the range of Rs. 123100 to Rs. 215900 per month, corresponding to Level 13.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for this post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Chief Administrative Officer-cum-Registrar (A-VIII) in the Software Technology Parks of India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official STPI website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening of online applications, followed by a personal interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates. However, General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Deputation position within the Software Technology Parks of India.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article, or by visiting the official STPI website.
